review_candidates.description: Whether you are already based in Northern Norway or currently working elsewhere in Norway, this role offers flexibility. Candidates who do not wish to relocate can choose from several work schedules, including weekly commuting, 3 weeks on/1 week off, or 10 days on/4 days off. Accommodation and travel arrangements are provided according to the agreed work schedule. English is the working language on site, making this an excellent opportunity for professionals from a wide range of project environments. About The Role As a Planner, you will develop and maintain project schedules, monitor progress, and help ensure that activities and milestones are completed on time. You will work closely with project managers, engineers, supervisors, and other stakeholders to provide clear visibility of project progress and identify potential delays or risks. Experience from construction is an advantage, but we also welcome candidates from engineering, oil & gas, energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, and other project-driven industries . Key Responsibilities Project Scheduling: Develop, maintain, and update project schedules and key milestones. Progress Monitoring: Track actual progress against plans and identify delays, deviations, and bottlenecks. Coordination: Work closely with project managers, engineers, supervisors, and other stakeholders to keep activities aligned. Reporting: Prepare schedule updates and progress reports to provide clear visibility of project status. Planning & Risk Support: Identify schedule risks and support forecasting and continuous improvement of project planning. Required Skills And Experience 1-5 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls within construction, engineering, industrial, infrastructure, energy, oil & gas, or similar project environments Understanding of project scheduling principles and construction workflows Experience using planning tools Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow up on deadlines Strong communication and coordination skills Professional or fluent English, both written and spoken It's a Plus if You Have Experience from large-scale construction projects Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar planning software Relevant education within engineering, construction management, project management, or related disciplines Experience supporting project controls, progress reporting, or forecasting activities Familiarity with large-scale or multi-disciplinary project environments Who We Are Looking For You are structured, proactive, and detail-oriented , with the ability to manage priorities and identify potential challenges before they affect project delivery. You enjoy working across teams and are comfortable in a fast-paced international project environment. What We Offer A permanent position Long-term career opportunities within a growing company The opportunity to work on large and technically advanced construction projects Flexible work schedules for candidates based outside Narvik A professional and multicultural project environment The opportunity to contribute directly to project success and delivery Ready for Your Next Challenge? We are looking to hire as soon as possible and review applications on an ongoing basis. Please submit your updated CV in English , highlighting your relevant planning, scheduling, and project experience. A formal cover letter is not required. You will receive a short questionnaire by email after submitting your application. Questions regarding the position can be directed to Lin Athea Chan at linathea.chan@toptemp.no .

review_candidates.title: AI Product Builder - Client Delivery
review_candidates.description: 🇪🇬 Up to EUR 35,000 per year, on a full time, contractor contract 🌎 Fully remote working anywhere in Egypt! ✨ Exciting high growth product, relied on by leading global brands, particularly within sports 💻 Modern stack, great tooling, AI-first engineering culture ABOUT US Storyteller is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that helps leading sports, media and entertainment brands create and deliver engaging content experiences across their owned digital products. Our platform includes native iOS, Android and Web SDKs, publishing tools, analytics and advertising support. We are remote-first, product-led and highly focused on execution. We value ownership, direct communication, sound judgment and people who improve the way work gets done rather than accepting recurring friction. About The Role We need a builder who can run a client. You'll own a major sports client's product rollout and the AI-enabled services that run alongside it. You'll configure it, build the automations around it, investigate what breaks, and keep it running and improving after launch. There's no project-manager layer and no handoff once it's live. It's yours. You won't write the core product code, but you'll know the product, its APIs, SDKs and configuration well enough to find problems yourself and give the client straight answers on trade-offs. What You'll Do Take client products and integrations from a messy brief to live (configuration, onboarding, testing, rollout) and keep owning them afterwards. Build and run AI-powered automations, tools and workflows that speed up delivery and make the product better for clients. Keep AI services reliable after launch: know what goes in and what comes out, check the output, and catch problems before the client does. Reproduce issues yourself by checking config, data and expected behaviour, then hand Engineering a clear problem, not a forwarded email. Decide what's worth fixing in your product area and work directly with engineers to ship it. Keep the client clear on progress and honest about constraints, and turn what you learn into changes Product and Engineering act on. Direct one or two more junior teammates, and leave behind tools and automation that make the next cycle easier. What We're Looking For You've built something with AI that's in real use: an automation, an agentic step in a pipeline, or a tool people rely on. Not chatbot use. You've taken a client-facing product or integration from brief to live, and kept running it after launch. You started somewhere technical (support, integrations, QA, development or similar) and grew into owning client or product outcomes. You're comfortable with APIs, SDKs, configuration and data, without needing to be an engineer. You've worked somewhere the process didn't exist yet: a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving agency, or something you started yourself. You make good calls with incomplete information and don't wait to be told before making progress. You communicate clearly and directly with both clients and technical teams. Nice To Have A background in sport, media, live events or ad-tech. Experience with SaaS or developer-facing products: SDKs, CMS, analytics. This Isn't For You If Your recent work is mainly running ceremonies, RAID logs, steering packs or account relationships, or you'd rather manage the people doing the work than do it yourself. RECRUITMENT PROCESS Short call focused on your experience and use of AI. Paid take-home task based on a real delivery and AI-operations problem. Use AI as much as you like; we'll ask what you accepted, changed, checked and rejected. Final interview with a member of the team.

review_candidates.description: Arbetsbeskrivning Samordna arbetet med informationssäkerhet, informationsklassning och dataskydd. Tjänsten innebär att du ansvarar för att samordna och utveckla informationssäkerhetsarbetet inom förvaltningen med fokus på systematiskt informationssäkerhetsarbete, planering, uppföljning och åtgärdsarbete. Det finns ett stort utrymma för utveckling inom området. Du bidrar med vägledning och praktiskt stöd till ledning och medarbetare inom informationssäkerheten för att säkerställa att förvaltningens information och personuppgifter hanteras i enlighet med rådande lagstiftning och styrdokument. Som utvecklingsledare kommer du att genomföra informationsklassningar, delta i upphandlingar, analysera systemstöd och säkerställa att information hanteras på rätt sätt. Du kommer vara kontaktperson mot tillsynsmyndigheten och säkerställa förvaltningens incidenthantering. Vidare ingår även att upprätthålla och utveckla dataskyddsarbetet inom förvaltningen, tillsammans med kollegor på enheten med uppdrag som dataskyddskontakter. I detta ingår bland annat att stödja verksamheten med konsekvensbedömningar, kontinuitetshantering, riskanalyser, kontroller och säkerhetsincidenter. Du kommer även ha ett samordnade uppdrag inom dataskyddsområdet. Du kommer att fortsätta den påbörjade implementeringen av NIS2-direktivet och kommande lagstiftning i förvaltningens verksamhet genom en strukturerad informationssäkerhetshantering. Du förväntas delta i nätverk och samverka med motsvarande roller på övriga förvaltningar inom staden. Du kommer också att ta fram styrande och stödjande dokument inom informationssäkerhet och dataskydd. I uppdraget ingår att utbilda och informera om informationssäkerhet och dataskydd på förvaltningen Kvalifikationer Akademisk examen inom området, t ex offentlig förvaltning, juridik, IT eller annan inriktning som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant för tjänsten. Dokumenterad kunskap i dataskyddsförordningen. Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med dataskyddsfrågor. Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med informationssäkerhetsfrågor. I rollen som utvecklingsledare behöver du ha ett strukturerat arbetssätt och god förmåga att driva frågor inom ditt område på både strategisk och operativ nivå. Många upplever området som krångligt, så vi tror att du behöver kunna kommunicera komplexa frågor på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du uttrycker dig mycket väl på svenska i såväl tal som skrift, och du anpassar din kommunikation efter mottagare. Det är viktigt att du kan organisera och prioritera arbetet på ett effektivt sätt och att du är van att arbeta självständigt. Vi förutsätter att du som person är noggrann, stresstålig med en god känsla för service och samarbetsvilja. Du tar ansvar för både dina egna och gemensamma arbetsuppgifter och har alltid verksamhetens bästa i fokus. Det är meriterande om du har Kunskap om MSBs föreskrifter om informationssäkerhet Relevant certifiering inom informationssäkerhet Arbetat med ledningssystem inom informationssäkerhet Erfarenhet av att förändrings- eller utvecklingsarbete Tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad och förutsätter godkänd säkerhetsprövning vilket bland annat innefattar drog- och alkoholtest, registerkontroll hos Säkerhetspolisen samt att du har svenskt medborgarskap. Välkommen med din ansökan! Om oss Kretslopp och vatten är till för göteborgarna. Vi ansvarar för att några av Göteborgs viktigaste samhällstjänster fungerar, alla dygnets timmar, hela året runt. Genom arbetet med vatten, avlopp och avfall bidrar Kretslopp och vatten till att skapa ett kretsloppssamhälle som möjliggör för göteborgarna att leva hållbart. Vår vision är ”Vi gör det lätt att leva hållbart” och vårt jobb är viktigt på riktigt. Göteborg växer som aldrig förr. Vi arbetar med att säkra dricksvattenförsörjningen till staden genom att bygga och underhålla staden under marken. Vi påverkar och planerar för byggandet av ett Göteborg som ska klara morgondagens klimatutmaningar. Vi arbetar även med att se till att det avfall som göteborgarna genererar samlas in och behandlas på rätt sätt. Vi arbetar långsiktigt med göteborgarens medvetenhet och beteende kring kretslopp och användningen av dricksvatten. Vi är en taxefinansierad förvaltning med stor fackkunskap med cirka 600 anställda. Inom organisationen har vi kompetens för att lösa vårt uppdrag – både när vi planerar och utför arbetet. Delar du vår vision och vill veta mer om oss? Besök gärna www.goteborg.se/kretsloppochvatten eller följ oss på Facebook, Linkedin eller Instagram. Övrigt Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Tillsvidareanställda på Kretslopp och vatten krigsplaceras inom ramen för förvaltningens roll i totalförsvaret. Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanbeder vi oss vänligen men bestämt att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

review_candidates.description: Up to £42,775+ earning potential | 4 on 4 off shift pattern | Career Progression and funded qualifications | North East Based At Nova Care Group, we know that supporting a young person through crisis and complexity takes more than experience on paper. It takes patience, resilience, the ability to stay calm when things are difficult, build trust when trust doesn't come easily and look beyond behaviour to understand what might be driving it. We know this because our organisation was founded on lived experience. We've seen first hand how much difference the right people, at the right time, can make in a young person's life. Now we're looking for people who want to make that difference too. The role We want to be honest with you, this isn't always an easy job but it will always make a difference. The young people we support have experienced significant challenges in their lives and often communicate their experiences through behaviours such as aggression, absconding, sexualised behaviours, self-harm, criminalisation or withdrawing from others. Your role is to stay calm, consistent and compassionate. To set clear boundaries, build trust and look beyond the behaviour to understand what a young person may be experiencing. There will be challenging times, difficult conversations and times when progress feels slow. Then there are the moments that make it all worthwhile. Seeing a young person begin to trust you, watching them manage something they couldn't before, seeing their confidence grow, their behaviour stabilise or taking another step towards independence. Requirements For Our Support Workers If you've worked in a demanding environment such as care, education, prison service, police, emergency services, armed forces, security, hospitality, retail or another role where you've had to remain calm under pressure, you'll already have many of the skills we're looking for. You’ll be: Fully flexible and able to work and travel across the North East Able to work 12 hours shifts, covering days, waking nights and sleep in shifts. In possession of a Full UK Driving licence and right to work in the UK (we are not able to offer sponsorship) What You'll Receive £30,000£32,000 basic salary Shift enhancements with earning potential of £42,775+ A 4 on 4 off shift pattern, giving you regular blocks of time away from work Enhanced annual leave, increasing with length of service Private healthcare cover Team bonus opportunities Fully funded Level 3 and Level 4 NVQ qualifications Clear career and progression pathways Paid sick leave Company pension scheme Refer a friend scheme Blue Light discounts Experience working with young people is helpful, but it's not essential. We'll provide the training and support you need to develop in the role. Nova Care Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of the young people we support. This role is subject to safer recruitment checks, including an enhanced DBS, employment history and reference checks.
